topicA: B2B SEO in the Age of AI Search
topicB: Demand Generation and Content Marketing Strategy

recap.intro: Welcome back, marketers! This week you explored two crucial areas of B2B marketing: how SEO is changing with AI search and effective demand generation strategies.
bullets: AI search queries are much longer and more like conversations, so your website content needs to put the main answer right at the beginning.
Building a loyal audience in B2B means actively showing your expertise and having real conversations, not just relying on data.
It's crucial to create content that both people and AI can trust, ensuring it reflects your brand's unique style even when using AI tools.
Understanding what your sales team needs and creating content that directly matches customer interests are key for successful demand generation.
recap.closing: This week you learned that B2B marketing success in the AI era hinges on creating trustworthy, direct content that truly connects with both human and artificial intelligence.
